author: Ducksfanwaterloo
body:
Hey guys, I've been wanting to make this for a while, and now I've finally gotten around to making this!  Just leave a request below if you want me to make you a skin, and I will do it as soon as possible :)

Just remember:  This is sort of like a joke skin shop, Do not expect anything I make to be good :P

When requesting, just do your best to describe what you would like, and I will try to make your dreams come true :)


Examples of my work:
